title: director.interrupts/1
description: data/director/interrupts.json: control-scheme step 3 (ADR 0008; control-rules.md sections 1, 2 and 6): the costs, cooldowns and windows of what a fighter does inside an exchange, read by sim/director/interrupt.gd (DirInterrupt). Ticks are sim ticks (60 a second); ki is out of 100. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore; every key required except the window classes (a class not listed has no window). Orders (a zip's band.minBh below maxBh, each inTicks lo at most hi, exit.capBh at most band.maxBh and towardDeg + awayDeg at most 180 (zip-order), and floor.minTicks at least 4 by Legal's RL-076 (zip-floor); a brawl flurry's minGap at most its maxGap its mul gaps strictly increasing, its runLapseTicks below its tradeMaxTicks, and a heavy's heldFullTicks at most its heldMaxTicks (brawl-order); a walk's minTicks at most its maxTicks; the split's width and power shares at most 1, a warning; kiPatient at most ki; the stale maximums are at least one repeat's step; a one-armed blocker keeps a window; light at most heavy; a window not longer than its wind-up, a warning) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (interrupts-*).

counterRush.description: The counter-rush approach: its speed (units a second) and its ticks.

flourishOverBh.description: With no press, a knock-back on the ground longer than this (body heights) ends in the flourish.

aiTapTicks.description: The AI taps this many live ticks into the window, from and to.

aiCounterTicks.description: The AI presses its counter-rush this many live ticks after the landing, from and to.

heavy.description: Game Design's 1a: a clean tapped heavy's recoil in a brawl.

enabled.description: False: the heavy staggers in place, as before.

reelTicks.description: With no flip, his reel at the slide's end.

freezeWindows.description: No window gets shorter for a freeze (rulings-2026-10-19b 4c), with hit-stop by weight on.

minLiveTicks.description: Live ticks a window at least this long keeps after a freeze.

calmTurn.description: The calm-moment turn, the director's part: the ask at a send, the pick, the hold.

landedTicks.description: Live ticks after he comes to rest from a send in which the landing's moment holds.

setSpeed.description: Under this speed (units a second) a free fighter is set.

warmCols.description: The least the host is asked to warm a frame, in columns.

warmColsMax.description: The most (the EP: 32): the rate asked is the columns over the ticks to the moment, between the two (the calm_turn cue carries it), and the swap waits the columns over it, in ticks, since the pick; a pausing form step whose new ring would need more is not a moment for one.

formTicks.description: Live ticks after a pausing form step's pause that are a moment.

predictMargin.description: At a send, added to the predicted spread from the pivot (units) when choosing a bearing that keeps World's moveMax.

score.description: What each place a turn brings into view is worth to the pick.

press.description: A player's attack press reacts on its own tick (Controls' T1).

skipOpenCool.description: A player's request is not held by the match's opening cooldown while no exchange has started.

ackQueued.description: A player's request still waiting after the drain is acknowledged on its press tick (press_ack, queued).

capTicks.description: After an exchange ends, the cooldown holds a player's request at most this many ticks (-1: off, the cooldown holds him as the AI).

setPieceCapTicks.description: ... after a set piece's end (a signature's exchange, a finisher, a tagged template, a throw).

setPieceTags.description: A planned exchange whose tag holds one of these is a set piece.

mash.description: A mash's later blows flow (light_flow): Game Design's 6 (b).

flowGapTicks.description: A mashed or burst blow within this many live ticks of the fighter's last one is a later blow of the run (light_flow).

wallKick.description: The wall kick: a dodge tap just before a sent body meets a wall that holds.

enabled.description: False: nothing runs and no cue is sent.

beforeTicks.description: Live ticks before the contact in which a dodge tap arms the kick.

minIntoWall.description: The least speed into the face (units a second) a kick takes; under it, Combat's plant.

keep.description: His kick-off speed, as a share of his arrival speed.

damageMul.description: The share of the slam's damage he takes.

pushTicks.description: His push off the face, in live ticks: his presses wait, then he has control again.

rushBlowTicks.description: A push toward the rival: his first blow within this many live ticks of its start is a rush blow.

towardDot.description: A push counts as toward the rival when its direction's dot with the way to him is at least this.

chase.description: The chase of a launch is the zip (Game Design's 7c).

speedMul.description: The chase flies at this times the sent body's speed ...

catchBh.description: Within this many body heights of him while he flies, the chase catches him.

sendForce.description: The force the catch's blow sends him on with (the launch planner's).

skyMul.description: The AI's chaseShare times this when the send goes up into open sky.

maxTicks.description: The longest chase, in live ticks.
